about.title: About Infinity Tax & Financial Services
text: Infinity Resolution helps individuals and small businesses resolve IRS and state tax problems — stopping collection action where possible, and building a clear, workable path back to compliance. We handle the parts of dealing with the IRS that are confusing, intimidating, or easy to get wrong, so you don't have to face it alone or guess at what to do next.

As we grow, our goal is to give more individuals and small businesses across the country access to the same level of hands-on, credentialed tax resolution help that's been available to our Texas clients from day one — without the impersonal, high-volume approach common in this industry
20 years in business tax, accounting, and payroll · IRS Enrolled Agent · Certified Tax Resolution Specialist
